title: 美国的家长会怎么开？英语怎么说？
summary: 美国家长会是一对一面谈，聊孩子的学习和表现。这篇教你怎么预约，以及面谈时的常用表达。

phrases.en: How is my child doing in class?
phrases.zh: 我孩子在班上表现怎么样？

phrases.en: What can we do at home to help?
phrases.zh: 我们在家能做些什么帮他？

phrases.en: My child needs extra help with math.
phrases.zh: 我孩子数学需要额外辅导。

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.en: Hi Ms. Lee, thanks for meeting with me. How is my son doing in class?
dialogue.zh: Lee 老师你好，谢谢你跟我面谈。我儿子在班上表现怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.en: He's doing well! He participates a lot. His reading has improved a lot this semester.
dialogue.zh: 他表现不错！上课很积极。这学期阅读进步很大。

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.en: That's good to hear. But his math homework always takes forever.
dialogue.zh: 听到这个很高兴。但他数学作业每次都写很久。

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.en: Math is a bit challenging for him. We have free tutoring after school on Tuesdays.
dialogue.zh: 数学对他来说有点难。我们周二放学后有免费辅导。

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.en: That would be great. What can we do at home to help?
dialogue.zh: 那太好了。我们在家能做些什么帮他？

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.en: Just 15 minutes of math practice a day. Thank you for coming!
dialogue.zh: 每天 15 分钟数学练习就行。谢谢你来！

seoDescription: 美国的家长会是一对一面谈。本文教你预约方法和面谈时的英语表达，附完整对话，第一次参加也不紧张。
